answer: Take a referral graph that refuses to pay itself. an inviter is paid only when the recruit is not kin-linked, and referral income is capped at what the inviter earns by mining. The consequence is that multiplying your own bots returns exactly zero; an attacker watching the reef of arrivals, the cipher of locked value and the hollow of audited grades finds the price rises faster than the payout. Nothing here needs a trusted referee.
